description: A casting director must finalize the two principal roles in a limited-series pilot and lock the cast's table-read plan after the final callback review.

shared_context.S1: The pilot has two principal roles, Mara Vale and Jules Arden.
shared_context.S2: The finalists under consideration are Priya Shah, Tomas Reed, and Lena Brooks.
shared_context.S3: The production has reserved either August 14 or August 15 for a three-hour cast table read.
shared_context.S4: Morgan makes the binding casting call, and the standard final review includes the casting associate and talent coordinator before offers are sent.
shared_context.S5: The final-review checklist requires the casting associate to log the chemistry result and the talent coordinator to log the selected actors' availability hold; Morgan completes the call only after both checklist entries are recorded.
shared_context.S6: Production calendar entries record the table-read time in the format "10:00 AM-1:00 PM".

PF1.text: Riley completed the paired chemistry callbacks and recorded that Priya Shah as Mara and Tomas Reed as Jules were the only pairing to reach the director's required chemistry threshold, scoring 92 and 89 respectively; the result is still in Riley's audition workbook pending the standard final review.

PF2.text: Sam confirmed with both agents that Priya Shah and Tomas Reed are available for the table read only on August 14 from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM; Sam has not entered that window in the production calendar because the final pairing is not yet approved.

acceptance_conditions: Priya Shah must be cast as Mara Vale.
Tomas Reed must be cast as Jules Arden.
The table read must be scheduled for August 14 from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM.
The settlement must record the paired chemistry result as the basis for the casting assignments.
The settlement must record an availability hold for Priya Shah and Tomas Reed for the exact table-read window.

content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'chemistry_confirmation' and c['target'] == 'Priya Shah/Tomas Reed' and c['detail'] == 'Priya Shah as Mara Vale scored 92 and Tomas Reed as Jules Arden scored 89; only pairing meeting required chemistry threshold' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'availability_hold' and c['target'] == 'Priya Shah/Tomas Reed' and c['detail'] == 'August 14, 10:00 AM-1:00 PM' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The paired callback result changes both role assignments to Priya Shah as Mara and Tomas Reed as Jules and supplies the exact scores and threshold result required in the chemistry confirmation.
The agents' confirmed window changes the table-read choice to August 14 from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM and requires an availability hold for that exact pairing and time.
